purpose: Single model mapping for task-owned research; declarative configuration, not proof of runtime activation.
authorization: Owner-authorized method maintenance only; research/training/agents/schedules/report generation remain paused until explicit scoped owner resume.

startup.unsupported_or_unreadable: record actual limitation; do not claim verified activation; do not launch merely to verify

decision.responsibility: Detailed complete task brief, important choices and final evidence-based decision; event-driven role, not periodic standby.

execution.responsibility: One logical owner completes preparation, implementation, ordinary repair, empirical evaluation, explanation and resumable handoff within admitted scope.

scientific_review.responsibility: Independent important scientific plan/result review; separate from execution authorship and final Astra decision; not per-fix approval.

reporting.responsibility: Report verified existing artifacts through the existing single hub and mail route; no new experiments or substituted final decisions.

ordinary_progress_or_repair: save small task state; do not repeatedly notify Astra or create polling turns
retired_schedules: Old fixed Astra/research rounds remain retired on future resume; preserve three existing Sol reporting cadences only within explicit resume scope.
evolution: Revise mapping from complete-task quality, empirical outcome and time/cost evidence as models improve; preserve historical science, cumulative exposure, budgets and device/order boundaries.
